verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence that touches many-item operations is security campaigns with Copilot Autofix and org-wide secret remediation, both of which imply acting on many alerts at once, plus Copilot agent mode generating edits across several files in one request. None of it explicitly documents a general bulk-operation feature, and the REST/GraphQL APIs and CLI are only building blocks that earn no credit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk actions on issues, PRs or repositories (e.g., multi-select edit, close or label), documented AI-driven batch operations across many items, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
